info.title: Superflow API
info.description: Read, filter, search, update, resolve, reply to and bulk-edit Superflow comments, and administer projects, pages, people, statuses, tags, review links and the workspace; manage and run review agents, schedule runs, push comments to trackers, post to Slack and subscribe to webhooks. Authenticate with a Superflow API key (sf_pat_) or an OAuth access token (sf_at_). Rate limit: 600 requests per minute per key.
